overview_description.description:
Ditto Network is secure execution infrastructure for AI agents that trade, earn yield, and interact with onchain markets without taking custody of users’ funds or private keys.

Users define approved contracts, chains, spending limits, markets, withdrawal rights, and risk parameters through scoped permissions. AI agents can then identify opportunities, while Ditto simulates, validates, and executes each action through a decentralized operator network.

Ditto supports use cases including prediction markets, autonomous yield strategies, smart trading, portfolio rebalancing, cross-chain execution, liquidation protection, and third-party agent skills. Its infrastructure is designed around non-custodial permissions, pre-set guardrails, simulation before settlement, operator consensus, and slashable security.

The network currently reports 16 independent operators, 317K+ simulations, and $200M+ restaked collateral securing execution. Ditto also operates live Ethereum vault infrastructure and is building toward a broader AI-agent execution marketplace.
